mapper.select: SELECT nur.id, nur.type, nur.news_id, nur.content, nur.been_read, nur.create_time, us.nickname AS senderName, us.avatar AS senderAvatar, ur.nickname AS recipientName, ur.avatar AS recipientAvatar FROM b_news_user_record nur LEFT JOIN b_user_main us ON nur.target_uid = us.uuid LEFT JOIN b_user_main ur ON nur.uid = ur.uuid ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

SELECT nur.id as newsId, ac.id, ac.article_id as articleId, ac.parent_id as parentId, ac.comment_grade as commentGrade, ac.comment_uid as commentUid, ac.target_id as targetId, ac.target_uid as targetUid, ac.content as content, ac.type as type, ai.article_title AS articleTitle, nur.been_read as beenRead, nur.create_time as createTime, um.nickname AS commentName, um.avatar AS commentAvatar FROM b_news_user_record AS nur LEFT JOIN b_article_comment AS ac ON nur.news_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN b_article_information AS ai ON ai.id = ac.article_id LEFT JOIN b_user_main AS um ON ac.comment_uid = um.uuid where ac.state = 0 and nur.type = #{type} and nur.uid = #{uid} ORDER BY nur.create_time DESC

SELECT nur.id as newsId, tc.id, tc.time_notes_id as timeNotesId, tc.parent_id as parentId, tc.comment_grade as commentGrade, tc.comment_uid as commentUid, tc.target_id as targetId, tc.target_uid as targetUid, tc.content as content, tc.type as type, tn.title AS title, nur.been_read as beenRead, nur.create_time as createTime, um.nickname AS commentName, um.avatar AS commentAvatar FROM b_news_user_record AS nur LEFT JOIN b_time_notes_comment AS tc ON nur.news_id = tc.id LEFT JOIN b_time_notes AS tn ON tn.id = tc.time_notes_id LEFT JOIN b_user_main AS um ON tc.comment_uid = um.uuid where tc.status = 0 and nur.type = #{type} and nur.uid = #{uid} ORDER BY nur.create_time DESC

SELECT nur.id as newsId, dc.id, dc.dictum_id as dictumId, dc.parent_id as parentId, dc.comment_grade as commentGrade, dc.comment_uid as commentUid, dc.target_id as targetId, dc.target_uid as targetUid, dc.content as content, dc.type as type, di.content AS worksContent, nur.been_read as beenRead, nur.create_time as createTime, um.nickname AS commentName, um.avatar AS commentAvatar FROM b_news_user_record AS nur LEFT JOIN b_dictum_comment AS dc ON nur.news_id = dc.id LEFT JOIN b_dictum_info AS di ON di.id = dc.dictum_id LEFT JOIN b_user_main AS um ON dc.comment_uid = um.uuid where dc.status = 0 and nur.type = #{type} and nur.uid = #{uid} ORDER BY nur.create_time DESC

SELECT nur.id as newsId, nur.type as type, nur.uid as recipientId, nur.been_read as beenRead, nur.create_time as createTime, um.uuid as senderId, um.nickname AS senderName, um.avatar AS senderAvatar from b_news_user_record AS nur LEFT JOIN b_user_main AS um ON nur.target_uid = um.uuid where um.state = 0 and nur.type = #{type} and nur.uid = #{uid} ORDER BY nur.create_time DESC
